body: RETIRED ref-789877acd571ad3953a4 (glm, REVIEW-E graphite half) at verified idle. The first attempt at 10:07:08 was held because two short-lived child processes of the harness were live. They were gone by the retry after its next idle, so nothing was stopped. The documented exit ran at 10:08:30, and the ledger reads retired 10:08:36. Its native record 4abb49cb-3b12-4444-baaa-0d12ac348620.jsonl is kept: the first 1949862 B are byte-equal to the pin taken before retirement (sha256 5b13f348); the only bytes after the pin are the harness's own exit lines (1952943 B now). KEPT, as you asked: ref-54f4f7dcfd67e7445c6b (grok, the version-9 record delta). It retires when you ask after that files. It is now the only robotics lead live.
